title: Data Validation Guidance | NHSN | CDC
content: NHSN Data Validation Print Minus Related Pages AT A GLANCE Data Accuracy : NHSN depends on precise data from healthcare facilities to achieve its surveillance goals and ensure accurate reporting of facility outcomes. Validation Resources : NHSN offers Internal and External Validation toolkits to help healthcare facilities and health departments assess infection control efforts and verify the reliability of submitted data. Take Action: NHSN validation is voluntary but encouraged as an effective way to enhance reporting accuracy and uncover improvement opportunities at your facility. On This Page 2023 Validation Toolkits 2024 Validation Toolkits 2025 Validation Toolkits Additional Resources External vs. Internal Validation NHSN provides tools and support for both external and internal validation efforts. Please refer to the table below to identify the differences between the two approaches. internal vs external validation External Validation Internal Validation What is it? A standardized process of external review of a facility’s surveillance procedures and reporting protocols A standardized process of internal review of a facility’s surveillance procedures and reporting protocols Who performs it? State or Local Health Departments Facility employees (Infection Preventionists, nurse, infection control staff) What is the purpose? Identify common issues related to NHSN data reporting and determine appropriate training activities and support needed at healthcare facilities Ensure that the facility’s surveillance data are of high quality: complete, timely, and accurate HAI’s Available for Validation Patient Safety Component: CLABSI, CAUTI, SSI-HYST, SSI-COLO, MRSA, LabID CDI Dialysis Component: Dialysis Event Long Term Care Component: Long Term Care LabID CDI Event Patient Safety Component: CLABSI, CAUTI, SSI-HYST, SSI-COLO, MRSA, LabID CDI, VAE How often is it performed? Varies by jurisdiction. An annual review for at least one HAI per jurisdiction is ideal. Annually, at minimum Data Validation by Year The NHSN Validation Toolkits have dedicated resources to help state health departments and healthcare facility staff validate Healthcare Associated Infection (HAI) data reported to NHSN.
